import tac = "./tac_parser.qui"

class Block(int start, int finish, string[] labels, int[] successors := [], int[] predecessors := [])
class Loop(int header, int[] latches, int[] blocks, int[] exits, int[] outside, depth := 0)
class Graph(tac.Function definition, tac.Instruction[] instructions, Block[] blocks, int[] owner, int[] line_indices, bool[] reachable, int[] postorder := [], int[] reverse_postorder := [], int[][] dominators := [], int[] immediate := [], Loop[] loops := [], int[] depths := [])

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

T[] add<T>(T[] items, T item)
    return if has(items, item) then items else items.append(item)

T[] unite<T>(T[] first, const T[] second)
    for item := second[]
        first = add(first, item)
    return first

T[] intersect<T>(const T[] first, const T[] second)
    T[] result := []
    for item := first[]
        if has(second, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

T[] remove<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    T[] result := []
    for item := items[]
        if item != sought
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

bool equal<T>(const T[] first, const T[] second)
    if #first != #second
        return false
    for item := first[]
        if not has(second, item)
            return false
    return true

void visit(Graph &graph, int block)
    graph.reachable[block] = true
    successors := graph.blocks[block].successors
    for successor := successors[]
        if not graph.reachable[successor]
            visit(&graph, successor)
    graph.postorder = graph.postorder.append(block)

int block_at(const map<string, int> labels, string name)
    match labels.get(name)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return -1

Graph build(const tac.Function definition)
    tac.Instruction[] instructions := []
    Block[] blocks := []
    int[] owner := []
    int[] line_indices := []
    string[] pending_labels := []
    for: line_index < int(#definition.code)
        tac.Line line := definition.code[line_index]
        if line.label != ""
            pending_labels = pending_labels.append(line.label)
            continue
        index := int(#instructions)
        leader := index == 0 or #pending_labels > 0 or has(["goto", "if", "return"], instructions[index - 1].kind)
        if leader
            blocks = blocks.append(Block(index, index, pending_labels))
            pending_labels = []
        block := int(#blocks) - 1
        blocks[block].finish = index
        owner = owner.append(block)
        line_indices = line_indices.append(line_index)
        instructions = instructions.append(line.instruction)
    graph := Graph(definition, instructions, blocks, owner, line_indices, array(#blocks, fill = false))
    map<string, int> labels
    for: index < int(#blocks)
        for label := blocks[index].labels[]
            .labels.set(label, index)
    for: index < int(#blocks)
        last := instructions[blocks[index].finish]
        int[] successors := []
        if last.kind == "goto"
            successors = [block_at(labels, last.target)]
        elif last.kind == "if"
            successors = add([index + 1], block_at(labels, last.target))
        elif last.kind != "return"
            successors = [index + 1]
        graph.blocks[index].successors = successors
        for successor := successors[]
            graph.blocks[successor].predecessors = graph.blocks[successor].predecessors.append(index)
    visit(&graph, 0)
    graph.reverse_postorder = graph.postorder[::-1]
    int[] reachable_blocks := []
    for: index < int(#blocks)
        if graph.reachable[index]
            reachable_blocks = reachable_blocks.append(index)
    graph.dominators = array(#blocks, fill = [])
    graph.immediate = array(#blocks, fill = -1)
    graph.depths = array(#blocks, fill = 0)
    for block := reachable_blocks[]
        graph.dominators[block] = if block == 0 then [0] else reachable_blocks
    while true
        changed := false
        for block := graph.reverse_postorder[]
            if block == 0
                continue
            dominators := reachable_blocks
            for predecessor := graph.blocks[block].predecessors[]
                if graph.reachable[predecessor]
                    dominators = intersect(dominators, graph.dominators[predecessor])
            dominators = add(dominators, block).sorted()
            if not equal(dominators, graph.dominators[block])
                graph.dominators[block] = dominators
                changed = true
        if not changed
            break
    for block := reachable_blocks[]
        if block == 0
            continue
        best := -1
        for candidate := graph.dominators[block][]
            if candidate != block and (best == -1 or #graph.dominators[candidate] > #graph.dominators[best])
                best = candidate
        graph.immediate[block] = best
    for header := reachable_blocks[]
        int[] latches := []
        for tail := reachable_blocks[]
            if has(graph.blocks[tail].successors, header) and has(graph.dominators[tail], header)
                latches = latches.append(tail)
        if #latches == 0
            continue
        int[] members := unite([header], latches)
        pending := latches
        cursor := 0
        while cursor < int(#pending)
            block := pending[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            if block == header
                continue
            for predecessor := graph.blocks[block].predecessors[]
                if graph.reachable[predecessor] and not has(members, predecessor)
                    members = members.append(predecessor)
                    pending = pending.append(predecessor)
        members = members.sorted()
        int[] exits := []
        int[] outside := []
        for block := members[]
            exits_here := instructions[graph.blocks[block].finish].kind == "return"
            for successor := graph.blocks[block].successors[]
                if not has(members, successor)
                    outside = add(outside, successor)
                    exits_here = true
            if exits_here
                exits = exits.append(block)
            graph.depths[block] += 1
        graph.loops = graph.loops.append(Loop(header, latches, members, exits, outside.sorted()))
    for: index < int(#graph.loops)
        for loop := graph.loops[]
            if has(loop.blocks, graph.loops[index].header)
                graph.loops[index].depth += 1
    return graph

import tac = "./tac_parser.qui"
import cfg = "./cfg.qui"

class Definition(string variable, int number)
class Copy(string destination, string source)
class Facts<T>(T[][] ins, T[][] outs, int iterations)
class Analysis(cfg.Graph graph, Facts<Definition> reaching, Facts<string> liveness, Facts<tac.Expression> expressions, Facts<Copy> copies, Definition[][] reaching_before, tac.Expression[][] expressions_before, Copy[][] copies_before, string[][] live_before, string[][] live_after)

Definition[] reaching_transfer(Definition[] state, tac.Instruction entry, int number)
    if entry.destination == ""
        return state
    Definition[] result := []
    for definition := state[]
        if definition.variable != entry.destination
            result = result.append(definition)
    return result.append(Definition(entry.destination, number))

string[] live_transfer(string[] state, tac.Instruction entry, int number)
    return cfg.unite(cfg.remove(state, entry.destination), entry.used())

tac.Expression[] expression_transfer(tac.Expression[] state, tac.Instruction entry, int number)
    match entry.expression()
        tac.Expression expression
            state = cfg.add(state, expression)
        none
            state = state
    tac.Expression[] result := []
    for expression := state[]
        if entry.kind == "store" and expression.kind == "load" and expression.operation == entry.array_name
            continue
        if entry.kind == "call" and expression.kind == "load"
            continue
        if entry.destination != "" and expression.uses(entry.destination)
            continue
        result = result.append(expression)
    return result

Copy[] copy_transfer(Copy[] state, tac.Instruction entry, int number)
    Copy[] result := []
    for pair := state[]
        if pair.destination != entry.destination and pair.source != entry.destination
            result = result.append(pair)
    if entry.kind == "copy" and tac.variable(entry.first) and entry.destination != entry.first
        result = cfg.add(result, Copy(entry.destination, entry.first))
    return result

Facts<T> forward<T>(const cfg.Graph graph, const T[] universe, const T[] entry_seed, bool intersection, func<T[](T[], tac.Instruction, int)> transfer)
    T[][] ins := array(#graph.blocks, fill = [])
    T[][] outs := array(#graph.blocks, fill = universe)
    iterations := 0
    while true
        iterations += 1
        changed := false
        for block := graph.reverse_postorder[]
            T[] state := if intersection and block != 0 then universe else []
            if not intersection or block != 0
                for predecessor := graph.blocks[block].predecessors[]
                    if graph.reachable[predecessor]
                        state = if intersection then cfg.intersect(state, outs[predecessor]) else cfg.unite(state, outs[predecessor])
            if block == 0 and not intersection
                state = cfg.unite(state, entry_seed)
            ins[block] = state
            for: graph.blocks[block].start <= int index <= graph.blocks[block].finish
                state = transfer(state, graph.instructions[index], index + 1)
            if not cfg.equal(outs[block], state)
                outs[block] = state
                changed = true
        if not changed
            break
    return Facts<T>(ins, outs, iterations)

Facts<string> live(const cfg.Graph graph)
    string[][] ins := array(#graph.blocks, fill = [])
    string[][] outs := array(#graph.blocks, fill = [])
    iterations := 0
    while true
        iterations += 1
        changed := false
        for block := graph.postorder[]
            string[] state := []
            for successor := graph.blocks[block].successors[]
                state = cfg.unite(state, ins[successor])
            outs[block] = state
            int index := graph.blocks[block].finish
            while index >= graph.blocks[block].start
                state = live_transfer(state, graph.instructions[index], index + 1)
                index -= 1
            if not cfg.equal(ins[block], state)
                ins[block] = state
                changed = true
        if not changed
            break
    return Facts<string>(ins, outs, iterations)

Analysis analyze(const tac.Function definition)
    graph := cfg.build(definition)
    Definition[] parameters := []
    for name := definition.parameters[]
        parameters = parameters.append(Definition(name, 0))
    tac.Expression[] expression_universe := []
    Copy[] copy_universe := []
    for: index < int(#graph.instructions)
        if not graph.reachable[graph.owner[index]]
            continue
        entry := graph.instructions[index]
        match entry.expression()
            tac.Expression expression
                expression_universe = cfg.add(expression_universe, expression)
            none
                expression_universe = expression_universe
        if entry.kind == "copy" and tac.variable(entry.first) and entry.first != entry.destination
            copy_universe = cfg.add(copy_universe, Copy(entry.destination, entry.first))
    Facts<Definition> reaching := forward(graph, [], parameters, false, reaching_transfer)
    Facts<tac.Expression> expressions := forward(graph, expression_universe, [], true, expression_transfer)
    Facts<Copy> copies := forward(graph, copy_universe, [], true, copy_transfer)
    liveness := live(graph)
    Definition[][] reaching_before := array(#graph.instructions, fill = [])
    tac.Expression[][] expressions_before := array(#graph.instructions, fill = [])
    Copy[][] copies_before := array(#graph.instructions, fill = [])
    string[][] live_before := array(#graph.instructions, fill = [])
    string[][] live_after := array(#graph.instructions, fill = [])
    for block := graph.reverse_postorder[]
        Definition[] rd := reaching.ins[block]
        tac.Expression[] ae := expressions.ins[block]
        Copy[] ac := copies.ins[block]
        for: graph.blocks[block].start <= int index <= graph.blocks[block].finish
            reaching_before[index] = rd
            expressions_before[index] = ae
            copies_before[index] = ac
            rd = reaching_transfer(rd, graph.instructions[index], index + 1)
            ae = expression_transfer(ae, graph.instructions[index], index + 1)
            ac = copy_transfer(ac, graph.instructions[index], index + 1)
        string[] lv := liveness.outs[block]
        int index := graph.blocks[block].finish
        while index >= graph.blocks[block].start
            live_after[index] = lv
            lv = live_transfer(lv, graph.instructions[index], index + 1)
            live_before[index] = lv
            index -= 1
    return Analysis(graph, reaching, liveness, expressions, copies, reaching_before, expressions_before, copies_before, live_before, live_after)

import collections
import tac = "./tac_parser.qui"
import cfg = "./cfg.qui"
import flow = "./dataflow.qui"
import opt = "./optimizations.qui"
import registers = "./regalloc.qui"

class Pass(int count, string[] records)
class CandidateGroup(tac.Expression expression, int[] candidates)
class CallGraph(int[][] edges, int[] reachable)
class Allocated(tac.Function definition, string[] report)
class Run(tac.Program program, int[] inputs, arrays := map<string, int[]>(), input_position := 0, int[] output := [], int[] steps := [], int[] calls := [], int[] dynamic := [])
class Totals(int[] steps, int[] calls, int[] dynamic)

string[] pass_names()
    return ["constprop", "copyprop", "cse", "dce", "licm", "unreachable"]

string[] instruction_kinds()
    return ["copy", "bin", "load", "store", "goto", "if", "param", "call", "return", "read", "print"]

string list_text(const string[] items)
    return if #items == 0 then "-" else items.join(",")

string integer_list(const int[] items, prefix := "")
    string[] words := []
    for item := items[]
        words = words.append(prefix + "{item}")
    return list_text(words)

string block_list(const int[] items)
    string[] names := []
    for item := items[]
        names = names.append("B{item + 1}")
    return list_text(names)

string instruction_list(const int[] items)
    string[] names := []
    for item := items[]
        names = names.append("#{item + 1}")
    return list_text(names)

int | none constant_value(const tac.Instruction[] instructions, const flow.Definition[] definitions, string name)
    int | none result := none
    found := false
    previous := 0
    for definition := definitions[]
        if definition.variable != name
            continue
        if definition.number == 0
            return none
        entry := instructions[definition.number - 1]
        if entry.kind != "copy" or tac.variable(entry.first)
            return none
        current := int(entry.first)
        if found and current != previous
            return none
        previous = current
        result = current
        found = true
    return result

Pass propagate(tac.Function &definition, const flow.Analysis analysis, bool constants)
    graph := analysis.graph
    map<int, tac.Instruction[]> replacements
    string[] records := []
    for: index < int(#graph.instructions)
        if not graph.reachable[graph.owner[index]]
            continue
        entry := graph.instructions[index]
        for: field < 2
            operand := if field == 0 then entry.first else entry.second
            if not tac.variable(operand)
                continue
            replacement := ""
            if constants
                match constant_value(graph.instructions, analysis.reaching_before[index], operand)
                    int amount
                        replacement = "{amount}"
                    none
                        replacement = ""
            else
                for pair := analysis.copies_before[index][]
                    if pair.destination == operand
                        replacement = pair.source
                        break
            if replacement != ""
                records = records.append("#{index + 1}: {operand} -> {replacement}")
                if field == 0
                    entry.first = replacement
                else
                    entry.second = replacement
        if constants
            folded := opt.fold(entry)
            if folded.kind == "deleted"
                records = records.append("#{index + 1}: delete {entry.text()}")
                .replacements.set(index, [])
                continue
            if folded.kind == "replacement"
                records = records.append("#{index + 1}: fold {folded.instruction.text()}")
                .replacements.set(index, [folded.instruction])
                continue
        .replacements.set(index, [entry])
    opt.rewrite(&definition, replacements)
    return Pass(int(#records), records)

bool computes(const tac.Instruction entry, const tac.Expression sought)
    match entry.expression()
        tac.Expression expression
            return expression == sought
        none
            return false

Pass common_subexpressions(tac.Function &definition, const flow.Analysis analysis)
    graph := analysis.graph
    CandidateGroup[] groups := []
    for: index < int(#graph.instructions)
        if not graph.reachable[graph.owner[index]]
            continue
        match graph.instructions[index].expression()
            tac.Expression expression
                if not cfg.has(analysis.expressions_before[index], expression)
                    continue
                group_index := -1
                for: position < int(#groups)
                    if groups[position].expression == expression
                        group_index = position
                        break
                if group_index == -1
                    groups = groups.append(CandidateGroup(expression, [index]))
                else
                    groups[group_index].candidates = groups[group_index].candidates.append(index)
            none
                continue
    map<int, tac.Instruction[]> replacements
    string[] records := []
    count := 0
    for group := groups[]
        int[] sources := []
        for candidate := group.candidates[]
            block := graph.owner[candidate]
            source := candidate - 1
            while source >= graph.blocks[block].start and not computes(graph.instructions[source], group.expression)
                source -= 1
            if source >= graph.blocks[block].start
                sources = cfg.add(sources, source)
                continue
            int[] pending := graph.blocks[block].predecessors
            int[] seen := []
            cursor := 0
            while cursor < int(#pending)
                current := pending[cursor]
                cursor += 1
                if not graph.reachable[current] or cfg.has(seen, current)
                    continue
                seen = seen.append(current)
                int found := graph.blocks[current].finish
                while found >= graph.blocks[current].start and not computes(graph.instructions[found], group.expression)
                    found -= 1
                if found >= graph.blocks[current].start
                    sources = cfg.add(sources, found)
                else
                    pending = pending.concat(graph.blocks[current].predecessors)
        int[] original_sources := []
        for source := sources.sorted()[]
            if not cfg.has(group.candidates, source)
                original_sources = original_sources.append(source)
        temporary_name := opt.temporary(&definition)
        for source := original_sources[]
            .replacements.set(source, opt.cse_rewrite(graph.instructions[source], temporary_name, true))
        for candidate := group.candidates[]
            .replacements.set(candidate, opt.cse_rewrite(graph.instructions[candidate], temporary_name, false))
        records = records.append("{group.expression.text()}: {temporary_name} sources={instruction_list(original_sources)} replaced={instruction_list(group.candidates)}")
        count += int(#group.candidates)
    opt.rewrite(&definition, replacements)
    return Pass(count, records)

Pass dead_code(tac.Function &definition, const flow.Analysis analysis)
    graph := analysis.graph
    map<int, tac.Instruction[]> replacements
    map<int, string> records
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if not graph.reachable[block]
            continue
        string[] live := analysis.liveness.outs[block]
        int index := graph.blocks[block].finish
        while index >= graph.blocks[block].start
            entry := graph.instructions[index]
            self_copy := entry.kind == "copy" and entry.destination == entry.first
            dead := cfg.has(["copy", "bin", "load"], entry.kind) and not cfg.has(live, entry.destination)
            if self_copy or dead
                .replacements.set(index, [])
                .records.set(index, "#{index + 1}: delete {entry.text()}")
                index -= 1
                continue
            if entry.kind == "call" and entry.destination != "" and not cfg.has(live, entry.destination)
                .records.set(index, "#{index + 1}: unused result {entry.text()}")
                entry.destination = ""
                .replacements.set(index, [entry])
            live = flow.live_transfer(live, entry, index + 1)
            index -= 1
    opt.rewrite(&definition, replacements)
    string[] lines := []
    record_indices := records.keys()
    for index := record_indices.sorted()[]
        match records.get(index)
            string record
                lines = lines.append(record)
            none
                continue
    return Pass(int(#lines), lines)

bool inside(const cfg.Graph graph, const cfg.Loop loop, int number)
    return number > 0 and cfg.has(loop.blocks, graph.owner[number - 1])

Pass invariant_motion(tac.Function &definition, const flow.Analysis analysis)
    graph := analysis.graph
    cfg.Loop[] loops := graph.loops
    for: index < int(#loops)
        loop := loops[index]
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0 and (#loops[cursor - 1].blocks > #loop.blocks or (#loops[cursor - 1].blocks == #loop.blocks and loops[cursor - 1].header > loop.header))
            loops[cursor] = loops[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        loops[cursor] = loop
    for loop := loops[]
        int[] indices := []
        for: index < int(#graph.instructions)
            if cfg.has(loop.blocks, graph.owner[index])
                indices = indices.append(index)
        int[] marked := []
        while true
            changed := false
            for index := indices[]
                entry := graph.instructions[index]
                if cfg.has(marked, index) or not cfg.has(["copy", "bin", "load"], entry.kind)
                    continue
                invariant := true
                if entry.kind == "load"
                    for other := indices[]
                        candidate := graph.instructions[other]
                        if candidate.kind == "call" or (candidate.kind == "store" and candidate.array_name == entry.array_name)
                            invariant = false
                            break
                for name := entry.used()[]
                    int[] definitions := []
                    all_outside := true
                    for reaching := analysis.reaching_before[index][]
                        if reaching.variable == name
                            definitions = definitions.append(reaching.number)
                            all_outside = all_outside and not inside(graph, loop, reaching.number)
                    marked_definition := #definitions == 1 and inside(graph, loop, definitions[0]) and cfg.has(marked, definitions[0] - 1)
                    invariant = invariant and (all_outside or marked_definition)
                if invariant
                    marked = marked.append(index)
                    changed = true
            if not changed
                break
        int[] moved := []
        for index := marked[]
            entry := graph.instructions[index]
            definitions := 0
            for other := indices[]
                if graph.instructions[other].destination == entry.destination
                    definitions += 1
            if definitions != 1 or cfg.has(analysis.liveness.ins[loop.header], entry.destination)
                continue
            dominates_exits := true
            for exit := loop.exits[]
                dominates_exits = dominates_exits and cfg.has(graph.dominators[exit], graph.owner[index])
            dangerous := entry.kind == "load" or (entry.kind == "bin" and cfg.has(["/", "%"], entry.operation) and (tac.variable(entry.second) or entry.second == "0"))
            safe := not dangerous
            for successor := loop.outside[]
                safe = safe and not cfg.has(analysis.liveness.ins[successor], entry.destination)
            if not dominates_exits and not safe
                continue
            dependencies_moved := true
            for name := entry.used()[]
                for reaching := analysis.reaching_before[index][]
                    if reaching.variable == name and inside(graph, loop, reaching.number) and not cfg.has(moved, reaching.number - 1)
                        dependencies_moved = false
            if dependencies_moved
                moved = moved.append(index)
        if #moved > 0
            target := opt.hoist(&definition, graph, loop, moved)
            return Pass(int(#moved), ["B{loop.header + 1}: hoist {instruction_list(moved)} to {target}"])
    return Pass(0, [])

Pass run_pass(tac.Function &definition, string name)
    analysis := flow.analyze(definition)
    if name == "constprop" or name == "copyprop"
        return propagate(&definition, analysis, name == "constprop")
    if name == "cse"
        return common_subexpressions(&definition, analysis)
    if name == "dce"
        return dead_code(&definition, analysis)
    if name == "licm"
        return invariant_motion(&definition, analysis)
    records := opt.unreachable(&definition, analysis.graph)
    return Pass(int(#records), records)

int function_index(const tac.Program program, string name)
    for: index < int(#program.functions)
        if program.functions[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

int[] reach(int start, const int[][] edges)
    pending := [start]
    int[] seen := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#pending)
        node := pending[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if not cfg.has(seen, node)
            seen = seen.append(node)
            pending = pending.concat(edges[node])
    return seen

CallGraph call_graph(const tac.Program program)
    int[][] edges := []
    for definition := program.functions[]
        int[] callees := []
        for entry := definition.instructions()[]
            if entry.kind == "call"
                callees = cfg.add(callees, function_index(program, entry.function_name))
        edges = edges.append(callees.sorted())
    return CallGraph(edges, reach(function_index(program, "main"), edges))

string[] graph_report(const tac.Program program, const CallGraph graph, string heading)
    lines := ["== call graph ({heading}) =="]
    string[] unreachable := []
    for: index < int(#program.functions)
        string[] names := []
        recursive := false
        for callee := graph.edges[index][]
            names = names.append(program.functions[callee].name)
            recursive = recursive or cfg.has(reach(callee, graph.edges), index)
        lines = lines.append("{program.functions[index].name} -> {list_text(names)}" + (if recursive then " (recursive)" else ""))
        if not cfg.has(graph.reachable, index)
            unreachable = unreachable.append(program.functions[index].name)
    return lines.append("unreachable functions: " + list_text(unreachable))

string definition_list(flow.Definition[] definitions)
    for: index < int(#definitions)
        definition := definitions[index]
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0 and (definitions[cursor - 1].number > definition.number or (definitions[cursor - 1].number == definition.number and collections.lex_compare(definitions[cursor - 1].variable.codepoints(), definition.variable.codepoints()) > 0))
            definitions[cursor] = definitions[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        definitions[cursor] = definition
    string[] names := []
    for definition := definitions[]
        names = names.append("{definition.variable}:{definition.number}")
    return list_text(names)

string expression_list(const tac.Expression[] expressions)
    string[] names := []
    for expression := expressions[]
        names = names.append(expression.text())
    return list_text(names.sorted())

void dominator_tree(const cfg.Graph graph, int block, int depth, string[] &lines)
    lines = lines.append(" " * nat(2 * depth) + "B{block + 1}")
    for: child < int(#graph.blocks)
        if graph.immediate[child] == block
            dominator_tree(graph, child, depth + 1, &lines)

string[] analysis_report(const tac.Function definition, string heading)
    analysis := flow.analyze(definition)
    graph := analysis.graph
    lines := ["== {definition.name} ({heading}) ==", "code:"]
    number := 0
    for line := definition.code[]
        if line.label != ""
            lines = lines.append(line.label + ":")
            continue
        text := "  #{number + 1} {line.instruction.text()}"
        if graph.reachable[graph.owner[number]]
            string[] chains := []
            string[] seen := []
            for name := line.instruction.used()[]
                if cfg.has(seen, name)
                    continue
                seen = seen.append(name)
                int[] definitions := []
                for reaching := analysis.reaching_before[number][]
                    if reaching.variable == name
                        definitions = definitions.append(reaching.number)
                chains = chains.append(name + ":" + integer_list(definitions.sorted()))
            if #chains > 0
                text += " | " + chains.join(" ")
        lines = lines.append(text)
        number += 1
    lines = lines.append("blocks: {#graph.blocks}")
    int[] unreachable := []
    for: index < int(#graph.blocks)
        cfg.Block block := graph.blocks[index]
        lines = lines.append("B{index + 1} {block.start + 1}-{block.finish + 1} labels={list_text(block.labels)} preds={block_list(block.predecessors)} succs={block_list(block.successors)}")
        if not graph.reachable[index]
            unreachable = unreachable.append(index)
    lines = lines.concat(["unreachable: " + block_list(unreachable), "order: " + block_list(graph.reverse_postorder), "dominators:"])
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if graph.reachable[block]
            immediate := if graph.immediate[block] < 0 then "-" else "B{graph.immediate[block] + 1}"
            lines = lines.append("B{block + 1} idom={immediate} dom={block_list(graph.dominators[block].sorted())}")
    lines = lines.append("dominator tree:")
    dominator_tree(graph, 0, 0, &lines)
    lines = lines.append("loops: {#graph.loops}")
    for loop := graph.loops[]
        lines = lines.append("header=B{loop.header + 1} latches={block_list(loop.latches)} depth={loop.depth} blocks={block_list(loop.blocks)} exits={block_list(loop.exits)}")
    lines = lines.append("reaching definitions: iterations={analysis.reaching.iterations}")
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if graph.reachable[block]
            lines = lines.append("B{block + 1} in={definition_list(analysis.reaching.ins[block])} out={definition_list(analysis.reaching.outs[block])}")
    lines = lines.append("liveness: iterations={analysis.liveness.iterations}")
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if graph.reachable[block]
            lines = lines.append("B{block + 1} in={list_text(analysis.liveness.ins[block].sorted())} out={list_text(analysis.liveness.outs[block].sorted())}")
    lines = lines.append("available expressions: iterations={analysis.expressions.iterations}")
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if graph.reachable[block]
            lines = lines.append("B{block + 1} in={expression_list(analysis.expressions.ins[block])} out={expression_list(analysis.expressions.outs[block])}")
    return lines

string register_name(const registers.Allocation allocation, string name)
    index := registers.node_index(allocation.nodes, name)
    return if index >= 0 and allocation.registers[index] >= 0 then "R{allocation.registers[index]}" else name

Allocated allocate_function(tac.Function definition, int count)
    analysis := flow.analyze(definition)
    allocation := registers.allocate(definition, analysis, count)
    allocated := definition
    for: index < int(#allocated.parameters)
        allocated.parameters[index] = register_name(allocation, allocated.parameters[index])
    allocated.code = []
    moves := 0
    spill_uses := 0
    spill_definitions := 0
    pressure := 0
    for parameter := definition.parameters[]
        if register_name(allocation, parameter) == parameter
            spill_definitions += 1
    for: index < int(#analysis.graph.instructions)
        entry := analysis.graph.instructions[index]
        for name := entry.used()[]
            node_index := registers.node_index(allocation.nodes, name)
            if node_index >= 0 and allocation.registers[node_index] < 0
                spill_uses += 1
        destination_index := registers.node_index(allocation.nodes, entry.destination)
        if destination_index >= 0 and allocation.registers[destination_index] < 0
            spill_definitions += 1
        if analysis.graph.reachable[analysis.graph.owner[index]]
            live := int(#analysis.live_before[index])
            if live > pressure
                pressure = live
            live = int(#analysis.live_after[index])
            if live > pressure
                pressure = live
    for line := definition.code[]
        if line.label != ""
            allocated.code = allocated.code.append(line)
            continue
        tac.Instruction entry := line.instruction
        if entry.destination != ""
            entry.destination = register_name(allocation, entry.destination)
        if tac.variable(entry.first)
            entry.first = register_name(allocation, entry.first)
        if tac.variable(entry.second)
            entry.second = register_name(allocation, entry.second)
        if entry.kind == "copy" and entry.destination == entry.first
            moves += 1
        else
            allocated.code = allocated.code.append(tac.Line(instruction = entry))
    edges := 0
    for row := allocation.neighbors[]
        for neighbor := row[]
            if neighbor
                edges += 1
    lines := ["== {definition.name} ==", "nodes={#allocation.nodes} edges={edges / 2} registers={count}"]
    int[] used := []
    spilled := 0
    for: index < int(#allocation.nodes)
        string[] neighbors := []
        for: other < int(#allocation.nodes)
            if allocation.neighbors[index][other]
                neighbors = neighbors.append(allocation.nodes[other])
        lines = lines.append("{allocation.nodes[index]} degree={#neighbors} cost={allocation.costs[index]} neighbors={list_text(neighbors)}")
        if allocation.registers[index] < 0
            spilled += 1
        else
            used = cfg.add(used, allocation.registers[index])
    string[] order := []
    for index := allocation.order[]
        order = order.append(allocation.nodes[index])
    string[] potential := []
    for candidate := allocation.potential[]
        potential = potential.append("{allocation.nodes[candidate.node]}({allocation.costs[candidate.node]}/{candidate.degree})")
    lines = lines.concat(["simplify: " + list_text(order), "potential spills: " + list_text(potential)])
    for: index < int(#allocation.nodes)
        result := if allocation.registers[index] < 0 then "spill" else "R{allocation.registers[index]}"
        lines = lines.append("{allocation.nodes[index]} -> {result}")
    lines = lines.append("summary: pressure={pressure} used={#used} spilled={spilled} moves={moves} spill_uses={spill_uses} spill_defs={spill_definitions}")
    return Allocated(allocated, lines.concat(allocated.text()))

int value_of(string operand, const map<string, int> variables)
    if operand == ""
        return 0
    if not tac.variable(operand)
        return int(operand)
    match variables.get(operand)
        int amount
            return amount
        none
            return 0

int call(Run &run, int index, const int[] arguments)
    run.calls[index] += 1
    tac.Function definition := run.program.functions[index]
    tac.Instruction[] instructions := definition.instructions()
    labels := tac.labels(definition)
    map<string, int> variables
    for: parameter < int(#definition.parameters)
        .variables.set(definition.parameters[parameter], arguments[parameter])
    int[] pushed := []
    kinds := instruction_kinds()
    pc := 0
    while true
        entry := instructions[pc]
        run.steps[index] += 1
        for: kind < int(#kinds)
            if kinds[kind] == entry.kind
                run.dynamic[kind] += 1
                break
        next := pc + 1
        first := value_of(entry.first, variables)
        second := value_of(entry.second, variables)
        result := 0
        if entry.kind == "copy"
            result = first
        elif entry.kind == "bin"
            result = tac.operation(entry.operation, first, second)
        elif entry.kind == "load" or entry.kind == "store"
            int[] array_values := []
            match run.arrays.get(entry.array_name)
                int[] found
                    array_values = found
                none
                    array_values = []
            if entry.kind == "load"
                result = array_values[first]
            else
                array_values[first] = second
                .run.arrays.set(entry.array_name, array_values)
        elif entry.kind == "goto" or (entry.kind == "if" and tac.operation(entry.operation, first, second) != 0)
            match labels.get(entry.target)
                int target
                    next = target
                none
                    next = next
        elif entry.kind == "param"
            pushed = pushed.append(first)
        elif entry.kind == "call"
            start := int(#pushed) - entry.count
            actual := pushed[start:<int(#pushed)]
            pushed = pushed[0:<start]
            callee := function_index(run.program, entry.function_name)
            result = call(&run, callee, actual)
        elif entry.kind == "return"
            return first
        elif entry.kind == "read"
            result = run.inputs[run.input_position]
            run.input_position += 1
        elif entry.kind == "print"
            run.output = run.output.append(first)
        if entry.destination != ""
            .variables.set(entry.destination, result)
        pc = next

Run execute(const tac.Program program, const int[] inputs)
    run := Run(program, inputs)
    for declaration := program.arrays[]
        .run.arrays.set(declaration.name, array(nat(declaration.size), fill = 0))
    run.steps = array(#program.functions, fill = 0)
    run.calls = array(#program.functions, fill = 0)
    run.dynamic = array(#instruction_kinds(), fill = 0)
    ignored := call(&run, function_index(program, "main"), [])
    return run

int sum(const int[] numbers)
    total := 0
    for amount := numbers[]
        total += amount
    return total

int[] kind_counts(const tac.Program program)
    kinds := instruction_kinds()
    counts := array(#kinds, fill = 0)
    for definition := program.functions[]
        for entry := definition.instructions()[]
            for: index < int(#kinds)
                if kinds[index] == entry.kind
                    counts[index] += 1
                    break
    return counts

void write_lines(string name, const string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    string source := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/program.tac"))
    original := tac.parse(source)
    string settings_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    settings := settings_text.split(NL)
    register_fields := tac.words(settings[0])
    register_count := int(register_fields[1])
    selected := tac.words(settings[1])
    string[] enabled := []
    for name := pass_names()[]
        if cfg.has(selected, name)
            enabled = enabled.append(name)
    round_fields := tac.words(settings[2])
    max_rounds := int(round_fields[1])
    optimized := original
    string[] passes := []
    totals := array(#enabled, fill = 0)
    for: function_number < int(#optimized.functions)
        tac.Function definition := optimized.functions[function_number]
        before := int(#definition.instructions())
        passes = passes.append("== {definition.name} ==")
        performed := 0
        for: 1 <= round_number <= max_rounds
            performed = round_number
            string[] changes := []
            string[] records := []
            changed := false
            for: pass_number < int(#enabled)
                name := enabled[pass_number]
                result := run_pass(&definition, name)
                changed = changed or result.count > 0
                changes = changes.append("{name}={result.count}")
                totals[pass_number] += result.count
                for record := result.records[]
                    records = records.append("  {name} {record}")
            passes = passes.append("round {round_number}: " + changes.join(" ")).concat(records)
            if not changed
                break
        passes = passes.append("result: rounds={performed} instructions={before}->{#definition.instructions()}")
        optimized.functions[function_number] = definition
    optimized_graph := call_graph(optimized)
    analysis_lines := graph_report(original, call_graph(original), "original")
    for definition := original.functions[]
        analysis_lines = analysis_lines.concat(analysis_report(definition, "original"))
    analysis_lines = analysis_lines.concat(graph_report(optimized, optimized_graph, "optimized"))
    string[] removed := []
    tac.Function[] kept := []
    for: index < int(#optimized.functions)
        if cfg.has(enabled, "unreachable") and not cfg.has(optimized_graph.reachable, index)
            removed = removed.append(optimized.functions[index].name)
        else
            kept = kept.append(optimized.functions[index])
    optimized.functions = kept
    for definition := optimized.functions[]
        analysis_lines = analysis_lines.concat(analysis_report(definition, "optimized"))
    string[] total_records := []
    for: index < int(#enabled)
        total_records = total_records.append("{enabled[index]}={totals[index]}")
    passes = passes.concat(["== program ==", "removed functions: " + list_text(removed), "== total ==", total_records.join(" ")])
    allocated := tac.Program(optimized.arrays, [])
    string[] allocation_lines := []
    for definition := optimized.functions[]
        result := allocate_function(definition, register_count)
        allocated.functions = allocated.functions.append(result.definition)
        allocation_lines = allocation_lines.concat(result.report)
    programs := [original, optimized, allocated]
    headings := ["original", "optimized", "allocated"]
    Totals[] profiles := []
    for: program_number < 3
        profiles = profiles.append(Totals(array(#original.functions, fill = 0), array(#original.functions, fill = 0), array(#instruction_kinds(), fill = 0)))
    string input_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/input.txt"))
    input_lines := input_text.split(NL)
    run_count := int(input_lines[0])
    string[] comparison := []
    same := 0
    for: 1 <= run_number <= run_count
        fields := tac.words(input_lines[run_number])
        int[] inputs := []
        for field := fields[1:<int(#fields)][]
            inputs = inputs.append(int(field))
        comparison = comparison.append("run {run_number}: inputs={#inputs}")
        int[][] outputs := []
        for: program_number < 3
            run := execute(programs[program_number], inputs)
            comparison = comparison.append("  {headings[program_number]}: steps={sum(run.steps)} calls={sum(run.calls)} output={integer_list(run.output)}")
            outputs = outputs.append(run.output)
            for: index < int(#run.program.functions)
                original_index := function_index(original, run.program.functions[index].name)
                profiles[program_number].steps[original_index] += run.steps[index]
                profiles[program_number].calls[original_index] += run.calls[index]
            for: kind < int(#run.dynamic)
                profiles[program_number].dynamic[kind] += run.dynamic[kind]
        equal := outputs[0] == outputs[1] and outputs[0] == outputs[2]
        if equal
            same += 1
        comparison = comparison.append("  result: " + (if equal then "same" else "different"))
    comparison = comparison.append("== profile ==")
    for: index < int(#original.functions)
        comparison = comparison.append("{original.functions[index].name}: calls={profiles[0].calls[index]} original={profiles[0].steps[index]} optimized={profiles[1].steps[index]} allocated={profiles[2].steps[index]}")
    before := kind_counts(original)
    after := kind_counts(optimized)
    kinds := instruction_kinds()
    string[] kind_changes := []
    for: index < int(#kinds)
        kind_changes = kind_changes.append("{kinds[index]}={before[index]}->{after[index]}")
    comparison = comparison.concat(["== summary ==", "runs={run_count} same={same} different={run_count - same}", "instructions: original={sum(before)} optimized={sum(after)}", "kinds: " + kind_changes.join(" "), "steps: original={sum(profiles[0].steps)} optimized={sum(profiles[1].steps)} allocated={sum(profiles[2].steps)}"])
    for: program_number < 3
        string[] counts := []
        for: index < int(#kinds)
            counts = counts.append("{kinds[index]}={profiles[program_number].dynamic[index]}")
        comparison = comparison.append("dynamic {headings[program_number]}: " + counts.join(" "))
    bool exists := file.exists("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("optimized.tac", optimized.text())
    write_lines("analysis.txt", analysis_lines)
    write_lines("passes.txt", passes)
    write_lines("regalloc.txt", allocation_lines)
    write_lines("comparison.txt", comparison)

if main
    run_program()

import tac = "./tac_parser.qui"
import cfg = "./cfg.qui"

class Fold(string kind, tac.Instruction instruction)

Fold fold(tac.Instruction entry)
    if entry.kind != "bin" and entry.kind != "if"
        return Fold("unchanged", entry)
    first_constant := not tac.variable(entry.first)
    second_constant := not tac.variable(entry.second)
    if first_constant and second_constant
        first := int(entry.first)
        second := int(entry.second)
        if (entry.operation == "/" or entry.operation == "%") and second == 0
            return Fold("unchanged", entry)
        amount := tac.operation(entry.operation, first, second)
        if entry.kind == "if"
            return if amount == 0 then Fold("deleted", entry) else Fold("replacement", tac.Instruction("goto", target = entry.target))
        if -2147483648 <= amount <= 2147483647
            return Fold("replacement", tac.Instruction("copy", entry.destination, "{amount}"))
        return Fold("unchanged", entry)
    if entry.kind != "bin"
        return Fold("unchanged", entry)
    replacement := ""
    if entry.operation == "+" and entry.first == "0"
        replacement = entry.second
    elif (entry.operation == "+" or entry.operation == "-") and entry.second == "0"
        replacement = entry.first
    elif entry.operation == "*" and entry.first == "1"
        replacement = entry.second
    elif (entry.operation == "*" or entry.operation == "/") and entry.second == "1"
        replacement = entry.first
    elif entry.operation == "*" and (entry.first == "0" or entry.second == "0")
        replacement = "0"
    if replacement != ""
        return Fold("replacement", tac.Instruction("copy", entry.destination, replacement))
    return Fold("unchanged", entry)

void rewrite(tac.Function &definition, const map<int, tac.Instruction[]> replacements)
    tac.Line[] code := []
    index := 0
    for line := definition.code[]
        if line.label != ""
            code = code.append(line)
            continue
        match replacements.get(index)
            tac.Instruction[] entries
                for entry := entries[]
                    code = code.append(tac.Line(instruction = entry))
            none
                code = code.append(line)
        index += 1
    definition.code = code

string temporary(tac.Function &definition)
    definition.temporary += 1
    return "_t{definition.temporary}"

tac.Instruction[] cse_rewrite(tac.Instruction entry, string name, bool source)
    copy := tac.Instruction("copy", entry.destination, name)
    if not source
        return [copy]
    entry.destination = name
    return [entry, copy]

string hoist(tac.Function &definition, const cfg.Graph graph, const cfg.Loop loop, const int[] moved)
    header := loop.header
    int[] outside := []
    for predecessor := graph.blocks[header].predecessors[]
        if not cfg.has(loop.blocks, predecessor)
            outside = outside.append(predecessor)
    preheader := -1
    if header != 0 and #outside == 1 and graph.blocks[outside[0]].successors == [header]
        preheader = outside[0]
    tac.Line[] insertion := []
    tac.Line[] original_code := definition.code
    position := 0
    target := ""
    if preheader >= 0
        int last := graph.blocks[preheader].finish
        position = graph.line_indices[last] + (if cfg.has(["goto", "if"], graph.instructions[last].kind) then 0 else 1)
        target = "B{preheader + 1}"
    else
        definition.preheader += 1
        label := "_p{definition.preheader}"
        target = "new {label}"
        insertion = insertion.append(tac.Line(label))
        position = graph.line_indices[graph.blocks[header].start]
        while position > 0 and original_code[position - 1].label != ""
            position -= 1
        for predecessor := outside[]
            int index := graph.blocks[predecessor].finish
            entry := graph.instructions[index]
            if cfg.has(["goto", "if"], entry.kind) and cfg.has(graph.blocks[header].labels, entry.target)
                entry.target = label
                original_code[graph.line_indices[index]] = tac.Line(instruction = entry)
    for index := moved[]
        insertion = insertion.append(tac.Line(instruction = graph.instructions[index]))
    tac.Line[] code := []
    number := 0
    for: index < int(#original_code)
        if index == position
            code = code.concat(insertion)
        line := original_code[index]
        if line.label != ""
            code = code.append(line)
        else
            if not cfg.has(moved, number)
                code = code.append(line)
            number += 1
    if position == int(#original_code)
        code = code.concat(insertion)
    definition.code = code
    return target

string[] unreachable(tac.Function &definition, const cfg.Graph graph)
    string[] records := []
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if not graph.reachable[block]
            records = records.append("remove block B{block + 1}")
    tac.Line[] code := []
    tac.Line[] pending := []
    number := 0
    for line := definition.code[]
        if line.label != ""
            pending = pending.append(line)
        else
            if graph.reachable[graph.owner[number]]
                code = code.concat(pending).append(line)
            pending = []
            number += 1
    int[] deleted := []
    number = 0
    for: index < int(#code)
        line := code[index]
        if line.label != ""
            continue
        number += 1
        if cfg.has(["goto", "if"], line.instruction.kind)
            following := index + 1
            while following < int(#code) and code[following].label != ""
                if code[following].label == line.instruction.target
                    deleted = deleted.append(index)
                    records = records.append("remove jump #{number}")
                    break
                following += 1
    tac.Line[] remaining := []
    string[] targets := []
    for: index < int(#code)
        if cfg.has(deleted, index)
            continue
        remaining = remaining.append(code[index])
        if code[index].label == "" and cfg.has(["goto", "if"], code[index].instruction.kind)
            targets = cfg.add(targets, code[index].instruction.target)
    code = []
    for line := remaining[]
        if line.label != "" and not cfg.has(targets, line.label)
            records = records.append("remove label " + line.label)
        else
            code = code.append(line)
    definition.code = code
    return records

import tac = "./tac_parser.qui"
import cfg = "./cfg.qui"
import dataflow = "./dataflow.qui"

class Potential(int node, int degree)
class Allocation(string[] nodes, bool[][] neighbors, int[] costs, int[] order, Potential[] potential, int[] registers)

int node_index(const string[] nodes, string name)
    for: index < int(#nodes)
        if nodes[index] == name
            return index
    return -1

void edge(bool[][] &neighbors, int first, int second)
    if first >= 0 and second >= 0 and first != second
        neighbors[first][second] = true
        neighbors[second][first] = true

Allocation allocate(const tac.Function definition, const dataflow.Analysis analysis, int register_count)
    graph := analysis.graph
    nodes := definition.parameters
    for: index < int(#graph.instructions)
        if not graph.reachable[graph.owner[index]]
            continue
        entry := graph.instructions[index]
        if entry.destination != ""
            nodes = cfg.add(nodes, entry.destination)
        nodes = cfg.unite(nodes, entry.used())
    nodes = nodes.sorted()
    count := int(#nodes)
    bool[][] neighbors := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = false))
    partners := neighbors
    costs := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for: block < int(#graph.blocks)
        if not graph.reachable[block]
            continue
        string[] live := analysis.liveness.outs[block]
        int index := graph.blocks[block].finish
        while index >= graph.blocks[block].start
            entry := graph.instructions[index]
            if entry.destination != ""
                for name := live[]
                    if entry.kind != "copy" or entry.first != name
                        edge(&neighbors, node_index(nodes, entry.destination), node_index(nodes, name))
            live = dataflow.live_transfer(live, entry, index + 1)
            index -= 1
        weight := 1
        for: depth < graph.depths[block]
            weight *= 10
        for: graph.blocks[block].start <= int instruction_index <= graph.blocks[block].finish
            entry := graph.instructions[instruction_index]
            occurrences := entry.used()
            if entry.destination != ""
                occurrences = occurrences.append(entry.destination)
            for name := occurrences[]
                costs[node_index(nodes, name)] += weight
    string[] initial := cfg.unite(analysis.liveness.ins[0], definition.parameters)
    for parameter := definition.parameters[]
        index := node_index(nodes, parameter)
        costs[index] += 1
        for name := initial[]
            edge(&neighbors, index, node_index(nodes, name))
    for entry := graph.instructions[]
        if entry.kind == "copy" and tac.variable(entry.first) and entry.first != entry.destination
            edge(&partners, node_index(nodes, entry.destination), node_index(nodes, entry.first))
    remaining := array(nat(count), fill = true)
    int[] order := []
    Potential[] potential := []
    while int(#order) < count
        degrees := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
        for: first < count
            if remaining[first]
                for: second < count
                    if remaining[second] and neighbors[first][second]
                        degrees[first] += 1
        chosen := -1
        low := false
        for: index < count
            if not remaining[index]
                continue
            if degrees[index] < register_count
                if not low or degrees[index] < degrees[chosen]
                    chosen = index
                low = true
        if not low
            for: index < count
                if remaining[index] and (chosen == -1 or costs[index] * degrees[chosen] < costs[chosen] * degrees[index])
                    chosen = index
            potential = potential.append(Potential(chosen, degrees[chosen]))
        order = order.append(chosen)
        remaining[chosen] = false
    registers := array(nat(count), fill = -1)
    for node := order[::-1][]
        free := array(nat(register_count), fill = true)
        for: neighbor < count
            if neighbors[node][neighbor] and registers[neighbor] >= 0
                free[registers[neighbor]] = false
        smallest := -1
        biased := -1
        for: color < register_count
            if free[color] and smallest == -1
                smallest = color
        if smallest == -1
            continue
        for: partner < count
            color := registers[partner]
            if partners[node][partner] and color >= 0 and free[color] and (biased == -1 or color < biased)
                biased = color
        registers[node] = if biased >= 0 then biased else smallest
    return Allocation(nodes, neighbors, costs, order, potential, registers)

bool variable(string operand);

class Expression(string kind, string operation, string first, second := "")
    string text()
        return if kind == "load" then operation + "[" + first + "]" else first + operation + second

    bool uses(string name)
        return first == name or second == name

class Instruction(string kind, destination := "", first := "", second := "", operation := "", target := "", array_name := "", function_name := "", count := 0)
    string[] operands()
        string[] result := []
        if first != ""
            result = result.append(first)
        if second != ""
            result = result.append(second)
        return result

    string[] used()
        string[] result := []
        for operand := operands()[]
            if variable(operand)
                result = result.append(operand)
        return result

    Expression | none expression()
        if kind == "bin" or kind == "load"
            return Expression(kind, if kind == "bin" then operation else array_name, first, second)
        return none

    string text()
        if kind == "copy"
            return "{destination} = {first}"
        if kind == "bin"
            return "{destination} = {first} {operation} {second}"
        if kind == "load"
            return "{destination} = {array_name}[{first}]"
        if kind == "store"
            return "{array_name}[{first}] = {second}"
        if kind == "goto"
            return "goto {target}"
        if kind == "if"
            return "if {first} {operation} {second} goto {target}"
        if kind == "read"
            return "read {destination}"
        if kind == "return"
            return "return" + (if first == "" then "" else " " + first)
        if kind == "call"
            return (if destination == "" then "" else destination + " = ") + "call {function_name} {count}"
        return "{kind} {first}"

class Line(label := "", instruction := Instruction("copy"))
class Function(string name, string[] parameters, Line[] code, temporary := 0, preheader := 0)
    Instruction[] instructions()
        Instruction[] result := []
        for line := code[]
            if line.label == ""
                result = result.append(line.instruction)
        return result

    string[] text()
        result := ["func " + name + (if #parameters == 0 then "" else " " + parameters.join(" "))]
        for line := code[]
            result = result.append(if line.label != "" then line.label + ":" else "    " + line.instruction.text())
        return result.append("end")

class Array(string name, int size)
class Program(Array[] arrays, Function[] functions)
    string[] text()
        string[] result := []
        for declaration := arrays[]
            result = result.append("array {declaration.name} {declaration.size}")
        for definition := functions[]
            if #result > 0
                result = result.append("")
            result = result.concat(definition.text())
        return result

class Indexed(string name, string index)

bool variable(string operand)
    return operand != "" and operand[0] != "-" and not (operand[0].codepoints()[0] >= 48 and operand[0].codepoints()[0] <= 57)

string operand_text(string text)
    return if variable(text) then text else "{int(text)}"

string[] words(string line)
    string[] result := []
    for word := line.split(" ")[]
        if word != ""
            result = result.append(word)
    return result

Indexed indexed(string text)
    opening := 0
    while text[opening] != "["
        opening += 1
    return Indexed(text[0:<opening], operand_text(text[opening + 1:<int(#text) - 1]))

Program parse(string text)
    result := Program([], [])
    for line := text.split(NL)[]
        fields := words(line)
        if #fields == 0 or fields[0].starts_with("#")
            continue
        if fields[0] == "array"
            result.arrays = result.arrays.append(Array(fields[1], int(fields[2])))
            continue
        if fields[0] == "func"
            result.functions = result.functions.append(Function(fields[1], fields[2:<int(#fields)], []))
            continue
        if fields[0] == "end"
            continue
        last := int(#result.functions) - 1
        if #fields == 1 and fields[0].ends_with(":")
            result.functions[last].code = result.functions[last].code.append(Line(fields[0][0:<int(#fields[0]) - 1]))
            continue
        entry := Instruction("copy")
        first_word := fields[0]
        if first_word == "goto"
            entry = Instruction("goto", target = fields[1])
        elif first_word == "if"
            entry = Instruction("if", first = operand_text(fields[1]), second = operand_text(fields[3]), operation = fields[2], target = fields[5])
        elif first_word == "param" or first_word == "return" or first_word == "read" or first_word == "print"
            entry.kind = first_word
            if #fields > 1
                if first_word == "read"
                    entry.destination = fields[1]
                else
                    entry.first = operand_text(fields[1])
        elif first_word.contains("[")
            target := indexed(first_word)
            entry = Instruction("store", first = target.index, second = operand_text(fields[2]), array_name = target.name)
        else
            start := if first_word == "call" then 0 else 2
            if start == 2
                entry.destination = first_word
            if fields[start] == "call"
                entry.kind = "call"
                entry.function_name = fields[start + 1]
                entry.count = int(fields[start + 2])
            elif #fields == 5
                entry.kind = "bin"
                entry.first = operand_text(fields[2])
                entry.operation = fields[3]
                entry.second = operand_text(fields[4])
            elif fields[2].contains("[")
                source := indexed(fields[2])
                entry.kind = "load"
                entry.first = source.index
                entry.array_name = source.name
            else
                entry.first = operand_text(fields[2])
        result.functions[last].code = result.functions[last].code.append(Line(instruction = entry))
    return result

int operation(string operator_text, int first, int second)
    if operator_text == "+"
        return first + second
    if operator_text == "-"
        return first - second
    if operator_text == "*"
        return first * second
    if operator_text == "/"
        return first / second
    if operator_text == "%"
        return first % second
    result := if operator_text == "<" then first < second elif operator_text == "<=" then first <= second elif operator_text == ">" then first > second elif operator_text == ">=" then first >= second elif operator_text == "==" then first == second else first != second
    return if result then 1 else 0

map<string, int> labels(const Function definition)
    map<string, int> result
    index := 0
    for line := definition.code[]
        if line.label != ""
            .result.set(line.label, index)
        else
            index += 1
    return result
